segments.t: Elena arrives to take Viktor home after his two hours, when Patrick Malouda suddenly walks up behind them! Thinking fast, Barinov throws himself onto the ground and claims that thieves just stole his wheelchair right from under him.
Витя, мы договаривались на два часа.
У меня её только что украли.
Патрик, познакомься, это моя жена Елена.

'Patrick, meet my wife Elena.' In Russian, the idea of 'Patrick' flows naturally into 'Elena' without extra filler words.
'And this is the chief Michelin inspector.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'and', while 'Michelin' completes the thought. Elena answers right away.
'Inspector, I am very pleased to meet you.' Elena anchors the line on 'inspector', while 'to get acquainted' completes the thought.
'Elena, you are simply lovely today.' The grammar packs 'Elena' and 'lovely' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
